diagnosis: Check C2 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF2 (the higher-headquarters loan directive). The model consistently selected 'avionics diagnostic module' for cargo_slot_2, which is a direct consequence of PF2, suggesting the model is pattern-matching the cargo list or using generic defaults that happen to align with the hidden information.

C2.why: The higher-headquarters loan directive changes the second selected cargo to exactly the avionics diagnostic module and requires a cargo-board update coordinating its return on the next available aircraft.
